chapter.verse: Tua ahih manin note tawh makai a semkhawm khat ka hihna leh Khris' gimthuaknate mit tawh a mu khat ka hihna tawh ahi zongin, a hong kilang ding minphatna sungah a kihel khat ka hihna tawh ahi zongin, note' laka makaite kong hanthawn hi.
Note' laka om tuuhonte cing unla, sawlzawh thu tawh ahilo, Pasian' hong deih bangin uttawm thu tawh, sum ngahnop man ahilo, utna tak tawh, kemin khoi un.
Note' kepna sunga omte' tungah kithuneisak kei unla tuuhonte' ading etteh lim suak un.
Tuucing Ukpa hong kilat ciangin a mual ngeilo minphatna lukhu na sang ding uh hi.

Tua mah bangin no a khangnozawte aw, khanghamte' kiangah na niamlut un. Na vekpi-un khatlekhat a niamzaw kituhna puan na silh un. A hang pen Pasian in a kiphasakte nialin a kiniamkhiatte hehpihna guan hi.
Tua ahih manin a kilawm hun ah hong sanglap theih nadingin Pasian' vanglian khut nuai-ah nomaumah kiniamkhiat un.
Pasian in note hong thudon ahih manin ama' tungah na lunghihmawhna khempeuh uh na suan un.
Lungsim tei sinsenin pilvang un. Na galpa uh dawimangpa pen a nektum theih ding a zong humpi hawk bangin vak kawikawi hi.
Amah langdo un. Leitung mun citeng pan na sanggampihte un zong hih bang gimthuakna namte mah na tuakkha uh ahihlam phawkin na upna uhah kipin om un.

Tawmvei sung gimna na thuak khit uh ciangin Khris sunga om ama' tawntung minphatna ah hong samkhia ahi, hehpihna namcin a nei Pasian mahmah in note hong bawlhoihkik ding a, hong kipsak, hong thahatsak, hong khosak ding hi.
Ama' tungah a tawntung a tawntungin ukzawhna om ta hen. Amen.
Sanggam citak khatin ka ngaihsut Silvanus tungtawnin lai tomno khat hong gelh ka hi a, hih na upna uh Pasian' hehpihna taktak hi cih teci pangin hong hanthawn ka hi hi. Hih thu ah kiptak ding un.
Note' teelngahpih ahi, Babylon khua-a om pen in zong note hong hopih a, ka tapa Mark in zong hong hopih hi.
It kinapna tawh khatlekhat na kihopih un. Khris sunga om note khempeuh' tungah nopna lemna hong om ta hen.
